newsitem.title: USA: No deal yet in U.S., EU meat talks -- EU official. [CORRECTED 20:46 GMT]
newsitem.headline: No deal yet in U.S., EU meat talks -- EU official. [CORRECTED 20:46 GMT]

text.p: A senior European Union official said Thursday that EU and U.S. negotiators have not yet reached an agreement to resolove a dispute over meat imports but that they were "getting closer."

Lars Hoelgaard, senior EU negotiator at the meat talks, said at a press briefing that he and other EU officials were staying in Washington for an extra day of talks. They had been scheduled to return to Brussels later Thurday. (Corrects that EU team continues talks in Washington on Friday)
Hoelgaard said it was not clear at this point if the talks would resume next week. There had been some speculation that the U.S. team would travel to Brussels next week to pick up the discussion.
The United States and the EU are trying to resolve a dispute that threatens to disrupt the trade of hundreds of millions of dollars worth of meat and poultry.

The negotiators met this week to try to reach an agreement in the so-called veterinary equivalency talks. The negotiations remain stuck on a handful of key issues, with a disagreement over decontamination systems in poultry processing appearing to be one of the biggest hurdles.
